# v2026.10.34

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.34.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.34.md).

This release covers **9 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Jobs can hold custom fields, and a stage move made in Flow is handed to Seazona to finish. ([#170](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/170))
- New invoice can start from a job, and Issue invoice waits until the invoice has a client and a due date. ([#164](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/164))
- Flow opens on the Ready tab of Invoices after sign-in. ([#168](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/168))
- The Jobs board fills the page, with wider lanes and cards that fit their text. ([#161](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/161))
- The Invoices list shows a Number column only on Issued and Void. ([#162](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/162))
- Logged errors reach Sentry under their own words, and Sentry traces show where the time goes between a click and its screen. ([#167](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/167), [#169](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/169))

## Changes

- Custom fields for jobs, and Seazona stage moves as a hand-off. ([#170](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/170))
- New invoice can start from a job, and Issue invoice waits for a client and a due date. ([#164](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/164))
- Open Flow on Invoices (Ready tab) after sign-in. ([#168](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/168))
- Sentry traces show where the time goes between a click and its screen. ([#169](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/169))
- Low-risk pull requests merge themselves when their checks are green. ([#171](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/171))

## Fixes

- Logged errors reach Sentry under their own words. ([#167](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/167))
- Jobs board fills the page, wider lanes, cards fit their text. ([#161](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/161))
- The Invoices list shows a Number column only on Issued and Void. ([#162](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/162))
